header.productTitle: SuperMouth Fluoride with Nano Hydroxyapatite Toothpaste
header.shortDesc: Prevent cavities, strengthen enamel, reduce sensitivity, and naturally whiten teeth with SuperMouth’s patented fluoride toothpaste for the whole family. Dentist-formulated with fluoride, nano hydroxyapatite, vitamins D3 & K2, prebiotics, and clean, safe ingredients, our advanced nanohydroxyapatite fluoride toothpaste supports optimal oral health for the whole family. Available in delicious family-friendly flavors: chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, and mint. It's the best tasting adults and kids toothpaste. Strengthen enamel, support enamel remineralization, reduce sensitivity, and naturally whiten teeth with SuperMouth's patented non-fluoride toothpaste with hydroxyapatite.
header.superHtml:
Get the best of both worlds—the proven cavity protection of fluoride combined with the benefits of a clean, advanced toothpaste formula designed for the whole family. SuperMouth’s innovative adults and kids fluoride toothpaste is expertly crafted for optimal oral care. This advanced formula helps support stronger, healthier smiles at every age.


Recognized among the best hydroxyapatite toothpastes by dental professionals, SuperMouth features our patented Liquid Enamel Technology™ powered by the proprietary Hydroxamin Complex—a unique blend containing at least 10% nano-hydroxyapatite, fluoride, vitamins D3, and K2. This powerful combination helps protect teeth, strengthen enamel, and support a healthier oral environment for the entire family.


This advanced formula is specifically designed to:

  • Effectively prevent cavities and tooth decay
  • Support natural enamel remineralization
  • Reduce tooth sensitivity
  • Promote a healthier oral environment over time
  • Provide safe, effective daily care for both adults and children

What Is Hydroxyapatite & Liquid Enamel Technology™?

Hydroxyapatite is a naturally occurring calcium phosphate mineral that makes up approximately 97% of tooth enamel. SuperMouth’s Liquid Enamel Technology™ enhances this mineral by combining fluoride and at least 10% nano-hydroxyapatite—naturally compatible with your tooth structure—with vitamins D3 and K2. Nano-hydroxyapatite helps fill microscopic imperfections in enamel, creating smoother, stronger teeth.


Fluoride and nano-hydroxyapatite work together to support enamel strength, protection, and resilience, helping reduce sensitivity and maintain long-term oral health. This makes SuperMouth an excellent choice for families seeking a trusted family toothpaste that supports healthy smiles from childhood through adulthood.


Key Benefits:

  • Clinically Proven Cavity Protection: Fluoride strengthens enamel and helps protect against cavities and tooth decay.
  • Expertly Formulated: Created by leading dentists and oral care specialists for advanced dental health.
  • Liquid Enamel Technology™ (Hydroxamin Complex): A proprietary blend of nano-hydroxyapatite (at least 10%), fluoride, vitamins D3, and K2 designed to strengthen enamel, reduce sensitivity, and enhance overall tooth health.
  • Xylitol-Enriched: Helps support moisture retention and a balanced oral environment.
  • Microbiome-Friendly: Free from harsh essential oils, alcohol, and antiseptics to help maintain the mouth’s natural balance.
  • Naturally Whitens: Gently removes surface stains without damaging enamel.
  • Low Abrasivity: With a Relative Dentin Abrasivity (RDA) of 67, it provides effective cleaning while remaining gentle on enamel.
  • pH-Balanced Formula: Helps maintain natural oral equilibrium for lasting freshness.
  • 100% Clean Ingredients: Free from artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners, preservatives, SLS, and antibiotics; non-GMO.
  • Prebiotic Support: Includes inulin and other prebiotics to help nurture a healthy oral microbiome.
  • Made in the USA: Formulated with premium, globally sourced ingredients.
  • Inclusive and Responsible: Gluten-free and paraben-free for a family-friendly oral care experience.

Transform your family’s oral care routine with SuperMouth’s Fluoride Toothpaste—a dentist-formulated solution designed for cavity prevention, stronger enamel, and brighter, healthier smiles. SuperMouth delivers advanced protection with a formula everyone can enjoy.

items.title: FAQs
items.html:
Why do some people choose fluoride toothpaste?
Fluoride toothpaste is a popular choice for both adults and children because of its proven ability to help prevent cavities and strengthen enamel. Fluoride is recognized for its cavity-fighting benefits and ability to make teeth more resistant to decay. SuperMouth’s adults and children's fluoride toothpaste is designed for family-friendly oral care.
What is fluoride toothpaste?
Fluoride toothpaste contains fluoride, a mineral that helps prevent tooth decay by strengthening tooth enamel and making it more resistant to acid attacks caused by plaque bacteria and sugars. SuperMouth’s Hydroxamin with fluoride toothpaste combines fluoride with nano-hydroxyapatite to provide advanced protection, enamel support, and remineralization for both adults and children.
What is nano-hydroxyapatite in oral care products?
Nano-hydroxyapatite is a naturally occurring mineral that closely resembles the minerals found in human tooth enamel. It helps support remineralization by filling microscopic enamel imperfections, restoring smoothness, and strengthening teeth. SuperMouth uses at least 10% nano-hydroxyapatite in its toothpaste formulas, providing enhanced enamel support for everyday use by both adults and kids.
How do fluoride and nano-hydroxyapatite work together?
Fluoride and nano-hydroxyapatite work together to provide comprehensive oral care benefits for the whole family. Fluoride helps strengthen enamel and protect against cavities, while nano-hydroxyapatite supports enamel remineralization, reduces sensitivity, and promotes natural whitening. Together, they create a powerful defense against tooth decay and enamel erosion, making SuperMouth an ideal adults and kids toothpaste.
What other ingredients are in SuperMouth’s Hydroxamin with fluoride toothpaste?
SuperMouth’s kids toothpaste formulas include prebiotics like inulin and xylitol to help support a healthy oral microbiome. The formula is made without harsh essential oils such as peppermint, eucalyptus, and tea tree oils, which may disrupt the mouth’s natural balance. It also contains no artificial colors, flavors, sweeteners, or preservatives, providing clean and effective oral care for the entire family.
What is Hydroxamin in SuperMouth products?
Hydroxamin is SuperMouth’s proprietary formulation that combines nano-hydroxyapatite, fluoride, vitamin D3, and vitamin K2 to support complete oral health. Nano-hydroxyapatite helps strengthen enamel by mimicking natural tooth minerals, while vitamin D3 supports healthy teeth and bones and vitamin K2 helps with proper calcium utilization. This balanced blend is carefully formulated to provide effective enamel protection and daily oral care for adults and children alike.

items.title: BEST NANO-HYDROXYAPATITE TOOTHPASTE FOR SENSITIVE TEETH
items.quote: “I was introduced to SuperMouth's products while writing our guide for creating the best oral health routine, and I like that the dentist-developed brand has toothpaste that use a combination of 10% nano-hydorxyatite and fluoride to support overall oral health. The low-abrasion formula is gentle on my teeth and the pH-balanced to help maintain a healthy oral environment. The brand also has a fluoride-free toothpaste option, which are offered in the same standard mint flavor as well as ice-cream-inspired varieties of vanilla, strawberry, and chocolate. Though these sweet flavors might sound strange at first, I found the chocolate flavor suprisingly delicious, and it's a good option for kids too. SuperMouth's toothpastes are made without artificial flavors, colors, sweeteners or preservatives, so don't be alarmed if the paste looks more beige than pure white; it will still clean and protect your teeth just as effectively.”
